description: P3 consumer-assertion: plugin/references/run-ledger-schema.md defines the completed_steps wave-marker convention (the free-form event.outputs.completed_steps array recorded per completed implement-loop wave). plugin/agents/overlord.md's Implement Loop (Wave Execution) section is the named consumer that reads/writes it, and the standard-delivery and pr-feedback-remediation workflow definitions describe the same per-wave checkpoint semantics in their state descriptions. Renaming or removing the convention in the schema doc, the overlord's wave loop section, or either workflow's wave-checkpoint description without updating the others is an unprotected coupling.

consumers.pattern: Molt one checkpoint commit for the whole completed wave, not per step.
Molt one checkpoint commit for the whole completed wave of remediation steps, not per step.
